changes.new_text: Insurance premiums and the cost of resolving large accident claims have increased significantly. Verdicts in excess of our insurance coverage could materially and adversely affect our financial condition.
New greenhouse gas emission standards for heavy-duty vehicles may require us to purchase more expensive equipment or retire tractors before the end of their useful lives.
Our credit agreement requires us to maintain a maximum leverage ratio. A further decline in earnings could cause us to breach this covenant.
Cargo theft, including fictitious pickups facilitated by identity fraud, has increased across the industry and could result in losses not fully covered by insurance.

changes.old_text: Fluctuations in the price or availability of diesel fuel could adversely affect our results of operations.
changes.new_text: Fluctuations in the price or availability of diesel fuel, and the reduced effectiveness of our fuel surcharge programs during periods of excess capacity, could adversely affect our results of operations.

changes.old_text: We may be unable to attract and retain qualified drivers, which could increase our costs.
changes.new_text: We may be unable to attract and retain qualified drivers and technicians, which could increase our compensation costs and limit our ability to grow dedicated operations.

changes.old_text: The trucking industry is highly competitive and fragmented.
changes.new_text: The trucking industry is highly competitive and fragmented, and excess capacity during the current freight downturn has put sustained pressure on our rates.

changes.old_text: Our planned acquisition of a regional less-than-truckload carrier may not be completed on the expected timeline.
Supply chain disruptions may delay deliveries of new tractors and trailers.

ask.answer: Son 10-K raporunda sigorta primlerinin ve büyük kaza tazminatlarının maliyetinin belirgin biçimde arttığı yeni bir risk olarak eklenmiştir [1]. Kredi sözleşmesindeki azami kaldıraç oranı şartının, kazançların daha da düşmesi hâlinde ihlal edilebileceği de belirtilmektedir [2].
